name: AZD-2327
summary: AZD-2327 is a δ-opioid receptor agonist which was under development for the treatment of depressive disorders and anxiety disorders but was never marketed. It is taken by mouth.

pharmacology.text: The drug showed antidepressant-like and anxiolytic-like effects as well as locomotor-stimulating effects in animal models. It had reduced induction of seizures and locomotor hyperactivity compared to other δ-opioid receptor agonists. The doses required for stimulant-like activity were 3- to 10-fold greater than the doses that produced antidepressant- and anxiolytic-like effects. The drug appears to have a very low misuse potential based on animal studies.

uses.text: AZD-2327 is a δ-opioid receptor agonist which was under development for the treatment of depressive disorders and anxiety disorders but was never marketed.

sideEffects.en: It was never marketed, so its effects in people are not well documented. Delta opioid agonists as a class have been limited by the risk of seizures seen in animal studies.
sideEffects.zh: 它從未上市，因此對人體的作用紀錄不多。δ 鴉片促效劑作為一類，其開發一直受到動物研究中癲癇發作風險的限制。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它从未上市，因此对人体的作用纪录不多。δ 鸦片促效剂作为一类，其开发一直受到动物研究中癫痫发作风险的限制。

fact.en: It targets the delta opioid receptor, the least used of the opioid family in medicine. Delta agonists have been of interest for mood rather than pain, but some cause seizures in animals.
fact.zh: 它針對 δ 鴉片受體，這是鴉片受體家族中在醫療上最少被利用的一個。δ 促效劑引起關注的是情緒而非疼痛，但其中有些在動物身上會引起癲癇發作。
fact.zhHans: 它针对 δ 鸦片受体，这是鸦片受体家族中在医疗上最少被利用的一个。δ 促效剂引起关注的是情绪而非疼痛，但其中有些在动物身上会引起癫痫发作。
